ns2:course.label: Elementary Korean I
ns2:course.description: First semester of Korean for students without any background of the Korean language, starting from the Korean alphabet (Hangul) and learning basic grammar, vocabulary, and commonly used expressions, to achieve beginning level of speaking, listening, reading, writing, and basic grammar skills in Korean. Credit is not given for KOR 201 if credit for KOR 221 has been earned.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for KOR 201 if credit for KOR 221 has been earned.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Senior or Graduate class standing.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Note: KOR 201 is for those with no Korean background. Students who have Korean background or have previously taken a course(s) in Korean must take the Korean placement test. Call 244-1432 for more information on the placement test.
